baseline.conditions: Two water stops and a storm reserve; walking convoy pace applies.

title: Water travels with the promise
daily_life: Ossara’s supply relies on handlers, salt grass, wells and animal rest. The caravan carries its dependence visibly: water, feed and cargo occupy the same finite load.
timing: Twelve days includes two water stops and a storm reserve. Do not assign two extra full days to those stops without increasing the total; their durations are not fixed by the old summary.
handoff: Before departure, record passengers, animal water, feed, accessible containers and the next confirmed water source. A promised well is not a measured refill.
story_option: A packbeast refuses a brilliant-looking shortcut. Checking the harness before the ground lets an ordinary fault and a genuine terrain hazard coexist.
production: Maintain six legs per sailfin packbeast. Count the same containers at each stop. This production reference does not assign a universal litre ration to all species.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
